Subject: Forecast buckets: commit/best-case/pipeline definitions & coaching session

Team —

Quick update and ask: after the accuracy review with Finance we agreed to tighten (and clarify) the definitions for the three forecast buckets we use when committing numbers: Commit, Best Case, and Pipeline. The goal is to reduce ambiguity at stage transitions and get more consistent commits for Q1 planning.

High level changes (attached PDF has full text and examples):
- Commit: contract signed OR fully executed statement of work + confirmed billing schedule OR signed legal docs awaiting PO (must have a named approver and committed close date).
- Best Case: strong commercial alignment (SOW in redlines OR verbal acceptance) with a high confidence timeline but not yet signed; internal legal or procurement steps pending.
- Pipeline: active engagement/opportunity but no confirmed acceptance or verbal agreement; still in discovery/solutioning.

Please read the attached "2027-forecast-buckets-v1.pdf" — it includes stage-to-bucket mapping (Salesforce stages -> bucket) and two worked examples including HQ deal (Hendrix Analytics) and a small ISV pilot.

Next steps / asks:
1) Confirm any objections to the wording by EOD Thursday (14 Jan).
2) Update any open deals you own in Salesforce to match the new bucket mapping by EOD Friday (15 Jan).
3) Join a 30-min coaching session for managers where we'll run through borderline examples and how to coach AEs; proposed slots are Wed 13 Jan 10:30 PT or Thu 14 Jan 15:00 PT — please indicate preference in the Doodle link in the shared Drive.

I've attached a short agenda (sales-coaching-agenda.xlsx) and a CSV with the Hendrix example showing stage changes (hendrix-example-stage-csv.csv). If you need a one-pager FAQ for your reps, tell me and I'll produce it.

Thanks — this is small paperwork that should meaningfully reduce the weekly forecast churn.

Connor O'Brien | Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Appreciate the clarity here. Two quick suggestions based on deal review this morning:
1) Add an explicit callout that "Commit" requires either a fully countersigned agreement OR a signed SOW with a documented invoicing cadence; verbal signoff alone without a named approver doesn't qualify. That helps with deals where legal asks for a final minor redline and the AE treats verbal OK as equivalent.
2) For Best Case, include a sub-bullet for procurement timelines >60 days (flag as long-lead) that should remain Best Case until docs are executed.

I'm happy to own the 10 minute section in the coaching session that walks through gray-area examples and how to push for a named approver/date. If others agree, I'll prepare 3 live examples (an enterprise, a mid-market, and a pilot) and we can record.

Attached: hendrix-example-stage-csv.csv (annotated).

-Karthik

Subject: Finalized: forecast buckets + confirmed coaching session (Thu 14 Jan 15:00 PT)

Thanks for the quick turnaround and feedback. Final decisions (incorporated into the attached PDF v1.1):
- Commit: requires either fully countersigned contract OR signed SOW with explicit invoicing cadence OR signed legal docs with a named approver and committed close date (no verbal-only commits). (Action: AEs to update deals; Owner: AE; Due: 2027-01-15 EOD)
- Best Case: commercial alignment with high confidence but missing final execution; flag deals with procurement timelines >60 days as Best Case until executed. (Action: Sales Ops to flag long-lead; Owner: Karthik; Due: 2027-01-18)
- Pipeline: discovery/qualification stage only.

Coaching session confirmed for Thu 14 Jan 15:00 PT — we'll record and drop the recording + a 1-page coaching script into the Drive after the session. Karthik will cover the grey-area examples and Marissa will demo a rep coaching script.

Action summary:
- All AEs: update your open deals to match new bucket mapping by EOD 15 Jan (Connor to pull a list of outstanding records after EOD).
- Sales Ops (Karthik): flag long-lead procurement deals in Salesforce and publish a view for managers by 18 Jan.
- Revenue Ops (Connor): publish one-pager coaching script and short FAQ by 19 Jan; upload recording and slides to Drive.

Related links: HubSpot company (Hendrix): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/78910 — I updated stage mapping for that account per Marissa's note.

If anything changes during the coaching session, I'll send an updated version but this is the working definition for next week's rollup.
